title: Architecture daemon — clarify integration status (F006 component-complete, serve-loop integration incomplete)
body: F006 is component-complete: the bounded debounce/deferral engine has module-level tests. The dashboard serve loop does not consume this engine, so automatic watch-and-regenerate behavior remains incomplete. Existing dashboard-build and supervisor post-commit regeneration paths remain operational. Complete the serve-loop integration with public-entry-point evidence, or explicitly retire that requirement. This entry clarifies status; it does not authorize implementation or alter existing approval boundaries. Basis: docs/reviews/2026-09-05-unreached-module-classification.md.
